description: Data underlying the publication: Coordinated Control of Photovoltaic Hybrid Energy Storage Hydrogen Generation System Based on DC-Bus Signaling Optimized Droop Control is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Mengfan Li. 该文件中包含基于混合储能的光伏制氢系统的 Simulink 模型。它包括光伏发电模型、混合储能模型和拟合电解制氢模型。该研究中使用的数据和参数都包含在仿真模型中，可实现光伏发电制氢过程的仿真和优化的下垂控制的部分验证。 Translation via Deepl.com:This file contains the Simulink model of the hybrid energy storage based PV hydrogen production system. It includes a PV power generation model, a hybrid energy storage model and a fitted electrolysis hydrogen production model. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: MATLAB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
